rv.q: Overflowing with effervescent enjoyment, this homage to serialized melodramas and superheroes is a perfect way to spend a chilly Autumn evening.
With that notable exception, though, Black Button Eyes has done a remarkable job of transferring this campy show to the stage.
However, you could also stay at home, find the original streaming online somewhere, and give a donation to seasonofconcern.org and practically accomplish the same thing.
The live version is good enough to make the audience chuckle, if not outright laugh, especially if you’re an “insider.”
